claim_boundary: This local bundle is not a preregistration. Execution is forbidden until an untouched study accession is fixed and this exact protocol is publicly timestamped.

primary_endpoint.name: mean regret of the HistoWeave action versus the training-fold global default
primary_endpoint.success_rule: bootstrap upper 95% confidence bound of mean(personalised_regret - global_regret) <= 0.02
primary_endpoint.superiority_rule: bootstrap upper 95% confidence bound of mean(personalised_regret - global_regret) < 0

fail_closed_rules: Any oracle-K result is descriptive only and cannot unlock personalised_set.
Any task, ground-truth, metric, method-panel, source-hash, or split-unit mismatch returns evidence_required.
Fewer than five evaluable independent units returns evidence_required.
Failure of the non-inferiority rule retains global_default.
All negative and missing-method outcomes are reported.
required_public_registration_steps: Choose and record one demonstrably untouched public study accession without inspecting outcomes.
Run the independence audit and record its hashes.
Fill the four null registration fields without changing endpoints or thresholds.
Publish the protocol hash on an independent timestamped service before any outcome download.
Set execution_permitted=true only after the public timestamp is independently visible.
